evidence: Changes net_processing block-serving logic for MSG_BLOCK and is labeled P2P.
rationale: Optimizes serving disk-backed MSG_BLOCK P2P requests by stripping witness bytes in place, achieving an 8.9x to 9.3x microbenchmark speedup over full block deserialization and reserialization. While worthwhile for resource usage and unblocking witnessless IBD work (#36476), legacy non-witness block requests are not the dominant path for modern peers.
